errors.text_span: Секторите са разположени във визуално низходящ ред по големина
errors.evidence: The description states that the sectors are arranged in visually descending order of size. However, if one follows the sectors counter-clockwise starting from the smallest green sector, the order of percentages is 9.1%, 13.6%, 36.4%, and 40.9%, which is an ascending order, not descending.
